purpose: Named historical entities the archive's works deal with, curated so that deposit->entity and entity->deposit are both traversable in the Hugging Face projection. This is a REGISTRY OF PERSONS, distinct from data/entity-index.json, which registers concepts and terms.
method: Each entity carries an explicit match pattern. Detection runs over title, description, keywords and wiki_article of ACTIVE deposits at build time; nothing is written back to the registry. Patterns are deliberately narrow: a deposit is tagged only where the name or its Greek form appears, not where a topic merely implies it.
rule: An entity is listed here when the archive holds work that deals with it, not when the name occurs in passing. Add patterns; do not widen existing ones to raise counts.

zero_count_note: An entity with no deposits is registered because the archive expects to hold work dealing with it, and states plainly that it does not yet. Simplicius and Nicolaus of Damascus are both at zero as of 2026-09-09: a looser first pass reported them present, matching 'simplicity' and Kierkegaard's pseudonym Nicolaus Notabene respectively. Patterns are not widened to raise counts.
omission_corrected_20260909: REVERTED, and the revert is the correction. On 2026-09-09 nineteen authorial identities — the Dodecad heteronyms, Lee Sharks, the orthonyms and named positions — were added here because deposit #1604 (about Rebekah Cranes) carried entities: ['sappho'] and not her name. That looked like an omission. It was CONFORMANCE: this register's rule is that an entity is listed when the archive holds work that DEALS WITH it, and #1604 deals with Sappho and is BY Cranes. Adding the heteronyms made the `entities` array mean two different things in different rows — 'about X' and 'by X' — which is exactly the collision the heteronyms crosswalk avoids by joining on creator only. The identities now live as typed edges in data/relations.jsonl (created_by, instantiates_heteronym) and as nodes in data/nodes.jsonl. This register stays what it says it is: ABOUTNESS.
